label: Breaker Position
description: Breaker position from 52a/52b contacts

label: Trip Status
description: Relay has issued a trip (latched until reset)

label: Trip Cause
description: Which protection element(s) tripped (latched)

label: Lockout (86)
description: Lockout relay active; closing blocked until reset

label: Breaker Failure
description: Breaker failed to open on trip (50BF)

label: Recloser State
description: Auto-recloser (79) state

label: Sync Check OK
description: Sync check (25) permits closing

label: Control Mode
description: Remote open/close accepted only in REMOTE

label: Relay Healthy
description: Relay self-test / watchdog OK

label: Active Settings Group
description: Active protection settings group (e.g. grid-tied vs islanded)

label: Trip Count
description: Number of protection trips

label: Operation Count
description: Breaker operation count

label: Breaker Wear
description: Accumulated contact wear as % of rated

label: Fault Current A
description: Phase A current at last trip

label: Fault Current B
description: Phase B current at last trip

label: Fault Current C
description: Phase C current at last trip

label: Fault Current N
description: Neutral/ground current at last trip

label: Last Trip Time
description: Unix time of last trip

label: Open Command
description: Write 1 to open the breaker

label: Close Command
description: Write 1 to close the breaker (subject to SyncChk and Lockout)

label: Trip Reset
description: Write 1 to reset latched trip targets and 86
